_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chiller-efficiency (docs/workbook/plant-chiller-efficiency.md), second run: chiller_efficiency with the rule's own generic ceiling (0.85 kW/ton, no params) instead of the ceiling calibrated from this plant's fault-free run (1.44 kW/ton, the lbnl-chiller dataset template). It is deliberately uncalibrated: the exercise compares the two runs to show why a design ceiling must come from the chiller's schedule or its own healthy operation. `camber datasets config lbnl-chiller --exercise plant-chiller-efficiency--generic --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path.
